name: agent-dock
description: Live subagents beside your files: splits another pane (filetree by default) or opens its own

hostPane.title: Host pane
hostPane.description: Id of another plugin's pane to split, agents below it (filetree's is "filetree"). Leave empty to always use agent-dock's own pane. The host plugin must be listed after agent-dock in enabledPlugins.

autoArchiveMinutes.title: Auto-archive after (minutes)
autoArchiveMinutes.description: Finished agents collapse into the archive at the bottom of the list after this many minutes; 0 leaves archiving to you. Archived agents are never removed.
